dedupe_keys.name: a dataset of multi level street block divisions of 985 cities worldwide

description: A dataset of multi-level street-block divisions of 985 cities worldwide is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jintong Tang et al. Street-blocks, as basic geographical units for dividing urban space, are widely used in urban planning and statistics. However, the availability and quality of street-block data vary significantly across different countries or regions worldwide. While developed countries tend to have mature urban street-block division systems and corresponding public data, such data in most developing countries are often incomplete or non-existent. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: Shapefile, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 13528945511 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
